ios.desc:
The AI-Powered Notetaking and Digital Planning App for iPad

Unlock your creativity and productivity with Oneboard, the ultimate iPad app for digital notetaking, journaling, and planning—all enhanced with AI capabilities! Whether you're a student, professional, or just someone who loves to stay organized, Oneboard brings your ideas to life with seamless handwriting recognition, intelligent document management, and a clutter-free interface designed for focus.

Key Features:

- AI-Enhanced Handwriting Recognition: Effortlessly convert your handwritten notes into text. Oneboard’s AI ensures near-perfect accuracy, making it easier than ever to search and organize your notes.
  
- Customizable Templates: Choose from a wide range of templates for planning, journaling, and more. Whether it's a daily planner or a creative sketchbook, Oneboard has a template to match your needs.
  
- Advanced Organization: Automatically categorize and tag your notes with the power of AI. Create notebooks, folders, and tags to keep everything tidy and accessible.
  
- Natural Writing Experience: Enjoy a realistic pen-and-paper feel with smooth, lag-free writing. Customize your digital pen with different colors, sizes, and styles.
  
- Seamless PDF Annotation: Annotate PDFs with ease—highlight, underline, and add notes directly on your documents.
  
- Smart Search: Instantly find what you’re looking for. Search across your entire library, even within handwritten notes and PDFs, powered by advanced AI search capabilities.

- iCloud Sync: Access your notes across multiple iPads with secure iCloud syncing. Wherever you are, Oneboard keeps everything up to date.

Why Choose Oneboard?

Oneboard isn’t just a note-taking app; it’s your digital partner, powered by AI to boost your productivity. Whether you're planning your day, brainstorming ideas, or keeping track of important documents, Oneboard adapts to your style, ensuring that everything you need is just a tap away.

Tailored specifically for the iPad, Oneboard takes full advantage of the Apple Pencil and the iPad's powerful display, offering a seamless and immersive note-taking experience like no other.

Get Started Today!

Download Oneboard now and experience the future of digital note-taking on your iPad. Perfect for students, professionals, and creative minds alike!

quotes.text:
After 8 months of building, I'm excited to finally release Oneboard, a simple and powerful note-taking app. My goal was to create a tool that makes organizing thoughts effortless, without unnecessary distractions.

Oneboard offers intuitive handwriting recognition, smart summaries, and seamless organization, all powered by OpenAI’s O1 model. The focus is on giving you a fast, reliable way to capture and refine your ideas without compromising privacy.

I built this for anyone who loves taking notes and wants something lightweight, intelligent, and streamlined.

As a 16-year-old developer from Germany, I spent the last eight months building something I’ve always wanted but couldn’t find—a note-taking app that fits the way I think. Oneboard is an AI-powered tool that helps you capture ideas naturally, whether it’s handwriting, sketching, or organizing thoughts in a way that makes sense. It has all the essential features without the distractions, and it’s become my go-to for staying creative and productive. This has been a deeply personal project, and I’m excited to share it with anyone who’s looking for a smarter, more intuitive way to take notes.
